employees.evidence: We are guided by five principles, in Safety, Environment, Community, Employees and Governance.

shareholders.evidence: disciplined management of capital and long-term value

innovation.evidence: Valero is leading through innovation, ingenuity and unmatched execution

result.analyst_notes: Confident, self-promotional tone led by scale claims ('world's largest') that are business description, not values. Uses first-person plural 'we' throughout. Environment and safety appear in the lead paragraph; community, employees and governance appear only as principle names. Commitments are mostly absolute ('the best-in-class', 'the highest standards'), with 'responsibly' the only hedge. Customers receive no direct value statement.
